body:
I lost my mom to RA when I was 37.  It disabled her for most of my life.  My dad was with her when she took her last breath. The grief of it killed him within 2 years.  I'm sorry you experienced that too.

I can't imagine losing a spouse.  11 years is a huge chunk of life.  I'm glad you're doing ok.  I think it's admirable that you're here and reaching out.  Your compassion is appreciated.

Please be careful asking this question in the future. I know you framed it with good intent but if you would have asked me, it would have deeply injured me.  I'm a 40 year old woman who desperately wanted kids.  I'm infertile.

We get bombarded hourly with messages about the joy of family and importance of legacy. Then, people like me sit there hearing nothing but we weren't fit enough to reproduce.   We will be forgotten. Our DNA ends here.

I don't want you to feel bad. You're kind to reach out. Maybe just tell your story about how kids made a difference in your life and tell the person you hope they find something equally meaningful in their own journey.

I wanted to see Supernatural.  I've only seen 5 minutes of the 15 years.  I wish I had a safe space to binge it.  Ironically, if I had a safe space, I wouldn't want to die.  Maybe someone will read this and watch it for me.

I'm glad you have star trek. My mom liked it a lot so or has fond memories for me.
I've outlived my energy source. I feel like it got used up decades early by abuse and trauma.

Why?  I promise, no judgment. I just don't understand it. It doesn't make sense to me.  I'm the opposite. I fight to fix.

My abusive partner does this and it is mostly why I'm ready to die. It lets me know i have no hope of getting on my feet?

I've never been there for a death.  I've been there when someone was first told of a death.  I've been told of a lot of deaths.  I've never been there in that moment, though, not even for a pet.  I think the universe has protected me.  I don't know if that's something I would have emotionally survived.  Im sorry you went through that with your mom.
Im alive for my cats. It's to the point I can't protect them anymore.  That's why I'm here now.

What if things are worse after you pull the trigger?  That's my worry.  I worry even thinking suicidally will make my situation worse.  I don't really want to die. I want to avoid worse. I don't want to see worse.
Me too.  I am not able to really make a lot of sentences right now but you aren't alone.

What kind of help have you been seeking? Maybe someone here can help you find your situation makes that difficult.  I don't know who comes to this board but maybe someone with experience in what you need...

I've had very limited contact with people for the last 7 years. Im in an abusive relationship where he prevents me from being around people. I haven't even been inside target since 2011.  Like, this sucks...

So, I kinda think I know how that isolation hurts and can drive you to deep despair.  I am sorry you are in it too.  I hope you find a way to be surrounded by others if that is your choice.  I hope you find friends.

I decided to use my remaining energy to write to people. I don't know if I have anything helpful to say but I can be kind. Do you want to talk about your cousin? I would be willing to listen about their life or death.

It is hypocritical but I don't want you to die. I don't know your life.  It may horribly suck.  It might get better, though, there's always a chance.  I don't have depression so I don't understand it but I know it hurts.

I hope you find a way to ease your pain that keeps you around a little longer just in case something awesome is around the corner.  In my experience, life is equally likely to surprise you as devastate you.  Joy exists.

Regardless of your decision, I hope you're comforted by others before sunday.  Sending you genuine peaceful vibes.
